description: Replacement of the existing flat roof lights over the ticket hall with hipped roof lights; and replacement of the existing Georgian wired glazing over the footbridge next to the ticket hall with clear glazing.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.  
 
Condition required to be imposed by Section 18(1) (a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended by section 91 of the Planning and Compensation Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:
 
E251028-2 Rev B
E251028-3 Rev B
E251028-4 Rev B
BCCCS-LU-PRM-D175_Z-DR-A-0101 Rev P01.1
 
To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile, and in the case of brickwork, facebond and pointing.
 
In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building, in accordance with Policy DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials (including colour and finish) specified on the Barons Court station schedule of material (received 16.09.2026) hereby approved. The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details.
 
To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
